items.title: HackerTube
items.creator: Andrej Karpathy
items.summary: Andrej Karpathy created a curated video platform in two hours by delegating nearly all development tasks to an AI assistant. Instead of writing code or running terminal commands manually, he directed the model to aggregate recommended media from tech forum comments, construct the UI, and harden the server. This project illustrates how modern software creation is transitioning from manual programming to high-level AI orchestration.
items.key_idea: AI assistants can now independently build, secure, and deploy full applications from high-level user instructions.
